FIELD GUIDE

How to play

Move

Walk the valley with WASD. Hold SHIFT to sprint and SPACE to jump.

Build

Aim at a surface with the crosshair. LMB breaks a block. RMB places the block in your hotbar.

Choose

Pick a material with 1–9 or the scroll wheel. The selected block is shown above the palette.

Fly

Press F to take to the sky. SPACE rises, SHIFT descends, and F lands you again.

✦

Everything you build is saved in this browser automatically. Use ESC to pause at any time.

Tip: the lake shore is a good place to start.
